Joint native B-spline functional mixed-effects model

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_mixed_effects.Rd

Fits a Gaussian joint functional mixed model with B-spline fixed coefficient functions and participant random B-spline intercept functions. Uses the native R package nlme; never invokes Python.

Usage

etr_fit_joint_bspline_functional_mixed_effects(
  trajectories, design, predictors, participant_column, dimension,
  fixed_basis_size = 6L, random_basis_size = 4L,
  spline_degree = 3L, reml = TRUE, maxiter = 500L
)

Arguments

trajectories

Finite complete native trajectory set on one grid.

design

Data frame containing unique curve_id and numeric predictors.

predictors

Character vector of unique fixed predictor column names; can be empty.

participant_column

Participant grouping column in trajectory metadata.

dimension

Response dimension name.

fixed_basis_size

Number of clamped fixed-effect B-spline basis functions.

random_basis_size

Number of random-intercept B-spline basis functions.

spline_degree

B-spline degree (1 through 5), requiring basis size at least degree+1.

reml

Whether to use REML rather than ordinary maximum likelihood.

maxiter

Maximum number of nlme optimizer iterations.

Value

S3 etr_joint_bspline_mixed list containing functional coefficients, pointwise standard errors, random-effect coefficient covariance, participant random functions, variance components, fitted and residual trajectories, a residual_correlation_matrix equal to the time-grid identity matrix, and an nlme::lme fitted model.

Details

This estimator implements the basic participant random-intercept, independent Gaussian error model with an unstructured B-spline random effect covariance. It does not fit random slopes, nested trials, or structured residual correlation. The returned object is an R S3 object, not the Python FunctionalMixedEffectsResult; full Python 1.2 source parity is not claimed.
